kinds.configuration: User-set preferences and UI state: toggles, home layout, theme/locale, per-app settings, the permission ledger, chosen cities/clock. Losing them costs a re-setup, not content — and they are device-local by design (a restored backup must not silently re-grant capabilities or move the user's theme across devices).
kinds.derived: State the app recomputes, or that is only meaningful for the current run: fired-notification flags, the RAG index id list, recent/recently-used lists, in-app history caches, the AI session pointer, a running countdown, the notification-centre history, debug counters.
kinds.device-state: Mirrors of OS/device state (wifi, bluetooth, cellular, flashlight). The device itself is the source of truth and re-reports on the next boot; restoring a stale copy could contradict the hardware.
kinds.meta: The backup blob itself — snapshotting a backup would copy it into itself.
